title: [Bug]: dut_console test fails on arista 7800
author: liamkearney-msft
body:
### Issue Description

Dut console tests fail on arista 7800 due to lack of ip for console on linecards. These chassis do not have console ports for linecards so skip the test for these chassis

### Results you see

fail due to no mgmt ip for console

### Results you expected to see

skip of test

### Is it platform specific

broadcom
